module_summary: HDLC bit-stream recognizer: a Moore FSM counts consecutive ones on the serial input and decodes states into discard, flag and error outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Moore FSM register counting consecutive ones, with DISC, FLAG, ERR states

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Decoded SFLAG state: six consecutive ones frame boundary

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Decoded SDISC state: stuffed zero after five ones to discard

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Decoded SERR state: seven or more consecutive ones

groups.name: hdlc_fsm
groups.description: Ones-counting FSM driven by serial input bit

groups.name: output_decode
groups.description: State compares producing disc, flag and err outputs
